subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 13, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 13, 2026

Welcome to today's edition of the AcreetionOS daily update, your go-to source for everything happening across our community. We have a busy day ahead with new kernel releases, security patches, and plenty of community highlights to share. Let us jump right into it.

In development news, Greg Kroah-Hartman has released two stable kernel updates for this Friday: Linux 7.2.5 and 6.18.51. These updates bring important fixes and improvements that our team is actively reviewing for integration into upcoming AcreetionOS builds. Stay tuned for when these land in our repositories.

On the commit front, our CI pipeline saw several improvements this week, including a fix for release workflow validation and an update to pass the -R flag to gh release create to avoid unnecessary checkouts. The AcreetionOS-Xlibre build also received a welcome addition with firefox-ublock-origin now included. These may be small wins, but they make a big difference in reliability and day-to-day user experience.

Our ecosystem continues to grow beyond the core distribution as well. Fluorite Browser, our Chromium fork focused on ad blocking and privacy enhancements, and Cryolite Browser, a GNU IceCat fork built for free-software enthusiasts, both receive ongoing attention and development. AcreetionMediaWriter also remains a handy tool for writing AcreetionOS images to USB from any operating system.

The community had something exciting to celebrate this week as EuroPython 2026 videos were published. The conference, held in Kraków, Poland from July 13 through July 19, featured a wide range of talks and presentations that are now available for everyone to enjoy. It is always great to see our community members engaging with the broader Python and open-source world.
